sentences.text:
1. This miscellaneous appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act has been filed against the award dated 29.11.2007 passed by Third Motor Accident Claims Tribunal Morena in Claim Case No.199/2007.
2.

entities.text: Third Motor Accident Claims Tribunal Morena
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted by counsel for appellant that the Claims Tribunal after exonerating the appellant/Insurance Company has applied the principle of "pay and recover".
In fact the principle of "pay and recover" should not have been applied.
3. Considered the submission made by counsel for applicant.

4. The Supreme Court, in the case of National Insurance Company Ltd. v. Swaran Singh and Ors. ,
reported in AIR 2004 SC 1535 , has held that even if the Insurance Company is exonerated, it can still be made liable to pay the compensation amount, with liberty to recover the same from the owner and driver of the offending vehicle.

entities.text: National Insurance Company Ltd. v. Swaran Singh and Ors
